body:
Build an unattended official Repo2RLEnv PR-to-task workflow with reproducible exports, independent native controls, preserved evidence and owned cleanup, without per-task human/LLM repairs.

**Implementation:** open/unmerged [#46](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/46) supplies validation; drafts [#50](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/50) and [#52](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/52) add installed generation/handoff and source-bound held retention. #52 passes 129 locked tests/hooks and both GitHub checks. [Installed/archive evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/2796424c/experiments/51-held-retention/installed-results.md). Main is not promoted; no automatic merge/release.

**Current experiment:** actual child [#53](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/53) has launched the checkpointed installed controller for two official-listed AnnData PRs (one fix and its backport). Native generation/controls are pending; no fresh accepted pair or new unique task is established. Same official model/settings, verifier and resource profile; no APT prefix, timeout change or extra repair. [Inputs](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/commit/c07470ee).

**Findings:** #45’s known Cobrapy export failed clean recipe reconstruction. #47’s explicit generic build policy reached 300-second verifier timeouts/null rewards inconsistent with late files. #49/#51 preserved those original bytes, verified anonymous HF copies and original owned cleanup without regrading. Installed retention covers this pinned failure family; unknown cases and unresolved admission/billing still hold.

**Budget/status:** at #53 launch, actual 9.596001/32 CPUh and $0.287646/11original calls; generation reserved 6.333333 CPUh and $13.07 plus the existing $10 archival reservation. Reservations are not spend. Same $90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra, existing reserved CPUs only. All earlier jobs are terminal; #53 is the active controller. Detailed logs/current accounting in comments.

Original #28 stays closed at 83 exports / 82 ever-positive / 67 ever-clean, 25 public-eligible / 58 Matchms withheld. Keep this epic/children open for review. Scientific acceptance, workflow completion and release readiness remain separate.
